baseline: Exact Cut23 cumulative ZIP; 129 inherited model cases and 34 Chromium editor scripts

cases.risk: Two arrows cross while the existing routing checks nodes only
cases.red: Cut23 mode enum has no crossing-aware option and routes ignore other arrows
cases.green: Pure geometry test yields crossing-free two-turn path for a simple X; browser selects new Property and verifies routed SVG

cases.risk: Ordinary users experience unexpected rearrangement of existing diagrams
cases.red: Changing legacy route behavior would move published figures
cases.green: Legacy direct and avoid unit tests unchanged; new mode explicitly opt-in

cases.risk: A perpendicular segment intersection is missed because one bbox has zero width
cases.red: Initial strict-intersection bbox shortcut rejected vertical-vs-horizontal proper crossing
cases.green: Corrected bbox pruning, explicit perpendicular regression

cases.risk: A crowded four-node X has no supported clear two-turn corridor
cases.green: Returns crossing/blocked/capacity; SVG marks arrow amber dashed with accessible title, no false-success clear

cases.risk: Previous hidden or transparent arrows still influence layout
cases.red: Past-arrow index cannot distinguish visible and hidden edges if populated naively
cases.green: Chromium Hide/Undo recalculates next route; only visible arrows included

cases.risk: Conditional routing changes mathematical source/target or lost edits after Undo
cases.red: Crossing-aware routing could wrongly rewire semantic graph
cases.green: Unit verifies immutable JSON/refs; Chromium JSON export and Undo/Redo tests

cases.risk: Large diagrams trigger quadratic or unbounded intersection work
cases.red: Naive crossing tests scale with arrows × candidates × polyline segments
cases.green: At 129+ previous arrows, status=capacity and amber warning; comparison budget per candidate; performance sample recorded

cases.risk: TikZ silently falls back to a crossing layout after on-screen detours
cases.red: Restricted TikZ does not support screen-space optimized routes
cases.green: Browser disables TikZ/PGF for crossing-aware morphism, preserves SVG/JSON

cases.risk: Crossing route and displayed label disagree due duplicate computation
cases.red: Cut23 calculates morphism route separately for rendered path and auto-label placement
cases.green: Cut24 computes one document-order map shared by renderer and label placement and export drawing

cases.risk: An SVG export overwrites the editing handle’s auto-label state
cases.red: Export-side draw() previously overwrote currentMorphismLabels global
cases.green: Only non-export draw updates editing-only map; Cut23 drag/undo browser suite remains passing

cases.risk: Illegal routing input becomes persisted without feedback
cases.red: New route enum unsupported by old JSON validator, unknown values need explicit rejection
cases.green: Schema and model accept only direct/avoid/avoid-crossings on morphisms; invalid import leaves scene intact

cases.risk: Long routing-mode caption is clipped inside narrow Properties panel, obscuring active behavior
cases.red: Cut23 morphism routing selector inherits a 53%-wide Properties field and the new text is much longer
cases.green: Cut24 gives routing a full-width field, concise selected label, and Chromium width assertion; retains expanded explanation below selector

verification.scope: Isolated Chromium and Node; clean-ZIP gate separately recorded
